details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:(Phases 3c/4b) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The Phase 3c bait commit can trigger the default self-triggered autofix skip and prevent the Phase 4b editor exercise from running.
  WHY: All three reviewers describe the same `[ai-autofix]`/`AUTOFIX_SKIP_SELF_TRIGGERED=true` gate interaction.
- scripts/analyze_soft_errors.py:(Phase 8) | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The soft-error analyzer can fail or emit empty output without distinguishing failure from “no soft errors.”
  WHY: All three reviewers note the non-blocking analyzer/report path and the lack of explicit failure telemetry.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:(orchestrate-decompose-test job) | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Cleanup failures can leave orphaned test issues and pollute later runs.
  WHY: Reviewers split between medium and low severity, but all describe the same insufficient cleanup robustness; highest severity is medium.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:(clarify-rejects-unsolvable-test job) | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The label assertion can race the clarification cycle and flake before `ai:awaiting-clarification` appears.
  WHY: All three reviewers describe the same immediate-assertion race in the clarify test.
- README.md: | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: New workflow variables such as `ALT_EDITOR_MODEL` are not documented in the README.
  WHY: All three reviewers identify the same documentation gap; one reports it without a severity label, while the others call it medium.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:(orphan-workflows-test job) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Dispatched workflow failures may not be surfaced correctly, allowing a failed child workflow to look successful.
  WHY: Two reviewers flag the same dispatch-and-poll failure-propagation risk.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:(e2e-alt-model-test job) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The alternate-model test lacks explicit fallback or diagnostics if the model is unavailable or returns unexpected output.
  WHY: One reviewer treats this as a low-severity robustness issue, while the others call it intended or not actionable; highest severity is low.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml: | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The new experimental jobs can block stable tagging without an explicit operational bypass.
  WHY: One reviewer flags a low-severity operational gap, while another treats it as an acceptable tradeoff; highest severity is low.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:(Phases 3c/4b) | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The bait commit design can trigger the self-triggered autofix skip and prevent the editor exercise from running.
  WHY: The `[ai-autofix]` head plus `AUTOFIX_SKIP_SELF_TRIGGERED=true` causes the gate to skip the reviewer/editor cycle.
- scripts/analyze_soft_errors.py:(Phase 8) | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The soft-error analyzer can fail silently or produce empty output without being distinguished from “no soft errors.”
  WHY: The analyzer is non-blocking, so a crash or empty report would not be surfaced.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:(orchestrate-decompose-test job) | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Cleanup failures can leave orphaned test issues behind.
  WHY: The job creates test issues, but the cleanup phase has no robust retry/error handling.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:(clarify-rejects-unsolvable-test job) | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The clarify test may assert on labels before the clarification cycle completes.
  WHY: The orchestrator can still be auto-answering when the test checks for `ai:awaiting-clarification`.
- README.md: | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: New environment variables introduced by the expanded workflow are not documented.
  WHY: `ALT_EDITOR_MODEL` and related variables are missing from the README variable tables.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:(orphan-workflows-test job) | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The job may not correctly propagate failures from dispatched workflows.
  WHY: Failures from `workflow-log-analysis`, `validation-refresh`, `update_workflows`, or `internal-memory-maintenance` may not bubble up cleanly.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:(e2e-alt-model-test job) | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The alternate model test does not specify fallback behavior if the model is unavailable or emits unexpected output.
  WHY: Failures would be harder to diagnose if `ALT_EDITOR_MODEL` is unavailable or behaves differently.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml: | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The new experimental jobs are wired into the validate/notify chain without an explicit operational bypass.
  WHY: A failure in one of the experimental jobs can block stable tagging with no documented escape hatch.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:(Phases 3c/4b) | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The bait commit design conflicts with the self-triggered autofix skip.
  WHY: A `[ai-autofix]`-prefixed commit pushed by the bot can cause the gate to skip the reviewer/editor cycle, so Phase 4b never removes the bait.
- scripts/analyze_soft_errors.py:(Phase 8) | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The soft-error analyzer can fail silently or return an empty report that looks like success.
  WHY: The analyzer is non-blocking and its output is only attached to Telegram release notifications.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:(orphan-workflows-test job) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The dispatch-and-wait pattern may not correctly propagate failure status from child workflows.
  WHY: A dispatched workflow can fail after launch, and without explicit polling error handling that failure may be missed.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:(clarify-rejects-unsolvable-test job) | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The label assertion may run before the clarification cycle finishes.
  WHY: The test can race the orchestrator’s auto-answer cycle and observe labels too early.
- README.md: | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `ALT_EDITOR_MODEL` and related test configuration are not documented in the README variable table.
  WHY: Operators need the variable documented to configure the alternate-model test correctly.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:(orchestrate-decompose-test job) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Cleanup failure can leave orphaned test issues in place.
  WHY: If cleanup does not run or fails, later runs can be polluted by leftover issues.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:(e2e-alt-model-test job) | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The alternate-model test lacks explicit fallback behavior when the model is unavailable or produces unexpected output.
  WHY: The test assumes the alternate model behaves like the primary model, so unexpected behavior is hard to diagnose.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml: | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: New experimental jobs are wired into release gating without an explicit bypass.
  WHY: If an experimental job fails, stable tagging is blocked with no documented escape hatch.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:(Phase 4b / Editor Exercise) | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The bait commit can trigger the default self-triggered autofix skip and prevent the editor exercise from running.
  WHY: With `AUTOFIX_SKIP_SELF_TRIGGERED=true`, a `[ai-autofix]` head pushed by the bot is skipped, so Phase 4b never removes the bait.
- scripts/analyze_soft_errors.py:(Phase 8) | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The soft-error analyzer can fail silently or produce empty output without being distinguished from “no soft errors.”
  WHY: The analyzer is non-blocking and no artifact verification ensures valid output.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:(clarify-rejects-unsolvable-test job) | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The clarify test can race the orchestrator’s auto-answer cycle and assert too early.
  WHY: `ORCHESTRATOR_MAX_CLARIFY_CYCLES` allows multiple clarification cycles, so the label may not yet be present.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:(orchestrate-decompose-test job) | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Cleanup failures can leave orphaned test issues behind.
  WHY: If cleanup fails or is skipped, leftover issues can pollute later runs.
- README.md: | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `ALT_EDITOR_MODEL` is not documented in the README.
  WHY: The PR introduces a new variable, but the README variable table does not list it.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:(e2e-alt-model-test job) | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The alternate-model test lacks fallback handling if the model is unavailable or returns unexpected output.
  WHY: If the alternate model behaves differently, failures may be difficult to diagnose.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml: | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: There is no emergency bypass for the new jobs blocking stable tagging.
  WHY: The workflow offers no explicit operational escape hatch if one of the experimental jobs fails.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
